findings.where: A1.6 item 3 ("37 lines contain D-272; 13 of them are the recital ...") and A1.7 (c2) ("13 later entries recite `D-272 is CONTESTED`")
findings.claim: The count 13 is a single-line grep artifact; the recital is carried by 20 later entries (D-273 through D-292), and the packet's accounting of 'the rest' omits seven of them.
findings.evidence: `grep -c 'D-272 is CONTESTED'` = 13 only because the phrase is split across a line break in 7 entries (COORD lines 14262 `D-272 is` / 14263 `CONTESTED`, and likewise 14713, 14804, 15290, 15416, 15968, 16069). Actual distribution of the 37 `D-272` lines: 13 inside the D-272 entry (13963–14046), 5 in D-273 (14066, 14076, 14082, 14121, 14129), 19 one-per-entry in D-274..D-292 (14161…16069). Every entry D-273..D-292 recites `D-272 is CONTESTED and is not on this no-cell-edit adoption branch`.
findings.fix: Recount with a line-join (e.g. `tr '\n' ' '`) and state: 20 later entries (D-273–D-292) carry the recital; under (c2) all 20 recitals would go stale, not 13.
